description: The WHOLE voice catalogue: every voice aicut can speak with, across ElevenLabs (platform stock AND this account's cloned and custom voices) and OpenAI. Free, instant. EVERY VOICE ID COMES FROM HERE: `generate_audio`'s `voice`, `generate_fake_text_video`'s `voice_left` / `voice_right` and `generate_image_story`'s `voice`. Never invent one (it fails AFTER the job exists and is charged); `list_models` publishes none. IT IS PAGED: an answer is at most `limit` entries (default 20, max 100). READ `total_matching` AND `has_more` BEFORE you say anything to the user: if `has_more` is true you saw a slice, and 'there is no X voice' on that basis is wrong. Continue with `cursor` = `next_cursor` and the SAME `provider` / `usable_for`. NARROW WITH `usable_for` ('audio' for `generate_audio`, 'fake_text', 'image_story'): every voice it returns is one that tool accepts. Only 'audio' narrows ElevenLabs, and barely (`generate_audio` goes through a reseller and cannot speak voices CLONED inside this workspace; the two video doors reach the whole library), so send `limit: 100` and check `has_more`. Read `usable_for` on each entry rather than inferring it from `category`. `providers` rides on every answer (per provider: `voice_count`, the doors it serves; a null count means that list is temporarily unreadable). EACH ENTRY: `id` (what you send), `provider`, `name`, `description` (ElevenLabs only), `category` (`premade` stock, `generated` cloned in this workspace, `professional` a Voice-Library voice: how you find the voice a user calls THEIRS; null for OpenAI), `labels` (gender, age, accent, use_case), `preview_url` and `usable_for`. Match the brief against `labels` and `description`, not the name. `preview_url` is an mp3 you cannot hear: propose 2-3 voices, each with its link (null for OpenAI), and let the user pick BEFORE any paid call; never generate one line in several voices to compare unless they ask and are told the total. Never dump the list or present a page as the catalogue.

cursor.description: The previous `next_cursor`. Send the SAME `provider` / `usable_for` with it: different filters are a 400, not a restart.

limit.description: 1-100, default 20 (a shortlist). The full library never fits in one result, whatever you pass.

provider.description: Restrict to one provider: `elevenlabs` (the live library, and the only provider `generate_audio` can use) or `openai` (8 voices). Omit for both.

usable_for.description: The door you are about to call: `audio`, `fake_text` or `image_story`. Every voice returned is one that tool accepts. `openai` with `audio` is a 400 naming the provider that does serve it.
